description.p: Kaaryasoochi (job list) schedules commands and scripts the way cron does, with a desktop window to create jobs, pick schedules and read each run's output.

ul.li: One-shot, interval and full crontab schedules, with a live preview of the next runs
Run history with exit codes and output, and a notification when a job fails
Retries, timeouts and per-job time zones
Jobs missed while the computer was off run once when it is back
English, Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, Sanskrit and Urdu

description.p: Jobs are run by a per-user background service (a systemd user service), as you and never as root, so they keep running after the window is closed.
